title: Fire Alarm Scan Feedback Record
description: User review feedback captured from the RoomPlan workflow. These records link model predictions to user corrections and can be promoted into higher-value training data after review and approval.

feedback_id.description: Unique identifier for the feedback event or consolidated correction record.

session_id.description: RoomPlan session identifier from the mobile workflow.

device_id.description: Device identifier within the exported or in-review session.

predicted_type.description: Model-predicted coarse public device type before user correction.

corrected_type.description: User-corrected or confirmed coarse public device type.

predicted_confidence.description: Original model confidence for the device prediction when available.

manufacturer_confidence.description: Original model confidence for the manufacturer prediction when available.

reviewed_by_user.description: True when the record represents an explicit user review action.

review_action.description: Primary user action taken during review.

notes.description: Optional user or reviewer notes about the correction.

captured_at.description: UTC timestamp when the feedback was captured.

evidence_frames.description: Referenced evidence frame identifiers associated with the reviewed device.

location_hint.description: Optional 3D location hint from the session export when available.

x.description: X coordinate in room units, typically meters.

y.description: Y coordinate in room units, typically meters.

z.description: Z coordinate in room units, typically meters.

room_id.description: Optional room identifier from the exported session.

wall_segment_id.description: Optional wall segment identifier for wall-mounted devices.

approved_for_training.description: Training promotion flag after downstream review. User feedback alone does not automatically imply training approval.
